what_is.heading: What Are Valorant Points and What Can You Buy With Them?
paragraphs: Valorant Points (VP) are Riot's premium currency for Valorant. You spend them in the in-game Store on weapon skin bundles, Night Market deals, the Premium Battle Pass and agent unlocks.
VP is tied to your Riot account and its region. It can't be traded, and you can't send VP from your balance to a friend.

official_prices.heading: Valorant Points Prices: Official Store vs DropMarket
official_prices.note: These are US prices. Riot prices VP in local currency, so a pack costs a different amount in Brazil, Turkey or the Philippines, and taxes can change the checkout total.

extras.label: Valorant prepaid cards
extras.detail: PC only and locked to the region they were bought for

delivery.heading: How Valorant Points Delivery Works
steps: Pick an offer that matches your account's region and your platform.
After checkout, send the seller what their delivery note asks for in the order chat.
If you get a prepaid code, redeem it in the Valorant client: click the VP icon next to Store, then Prepaid Cards & Codes.
Check your VP balance, then confirm the order.

support_topic.heading: Do Valorant Points Work in Every Region?
paragraphs: No. Valorant prepaid codes only work on the server region they were issued for. A US code won't redeem on a Brazil or Turkey account, and you'll see "This Code is Not Valid in Your Region".
What matters is the region your Riot account is registered to, not where you are. Pick an offer for that region, and if you're not sure, ask the seller before you pay.

faq_extra.a: Only as a new purchase on PC. Riot lets friends of at least one week gift VP or featured bundles, but you can't send VP from your current balance. The sender needs account level 15, both players must be on the same shard, and you can send 10 gifts a day.

faq_extra.q: Do Valorant prepaid cards work on console?
faq_extra.a: No. Riot says Valorant prepaid cards are PC only.
